name: Midnight Static
description: Debut LP pressed on 180g smoke-black vinyl. Slow-burning shoegaze with a warm analog low end.

name: Coastline Sessions
description: Live-to-tape jazz fusion recorded on a pier in Goa. Includes a 12-page liner note booklet.

name: Concrete Bloom
description: Afrobeat-forward instrumental record. Double LP, gatefold sleeve with screen-printed artwork.

name: Paper Moon EP
description: Four-track ambient EP on translucent amber vinyl. Limited pressing of 500.

name: The Orbit MK1
description: Belt-drive turntable with a solid walnut plinth and built-in phono preamp. Auto-stop tonearm.

name: Lowdown DJ Deck
description: Direct-drive turntable built for scratching and beat-matching. Adjustable pitch fader, high torque motor.

name: Field Recorder Portable
description: Battery-powered suitcase turntable for record store days and backyard sessions. Built-in stereo speakers.

name: Studio Wrap Headphones
description: Closed-back over-ear headphones tuned for warm mids. Memory-foam cups, detachable coiled cable.

name: Open Air Monitors
description: Open-back reference headphones for critical listening. Wide soundstage, breathable earpads.

name: Commuter Buds
description: Compact wired earbuds with a warm, vinyl-like tonal balance. Comes in a felt-lined tin.

name: Diamond Tip Cartridge
description: Elliptical diamond stylus replacement cartridge. Fits most standard headshells.

name: Anti-Static Sleeve Pack
description: Set of 25 rice-paper inner sleeves. Keeps static and dust off your pressings.

name: Felt Turntable Mat
description: Forest-green wool felt mat. Reduces static and platter resonance.

name: Record Cleaning Kit
description: Carbon-fiber brush, cleaning fluid, and microfiber cloth. Everything for a pre-spin ritual.

name: Harborlight
description: Sophomore folk record, recorded live in a lighthouse. Pressed on translucent blue vinyl.

name: Desk Amp Companion
description: Compact headphone amplifier with warm tube-style coloration. Pairs with any wired headphone set.
